history.title: Our History
history.description: On March 24, 1972 we opened our doors as CECOM Procesamiento de Datos C. por A., teaching the first generations of programmers and analysts in the Dominican Republic. Over the decades we evolved into CECOM S.A.S., pioneering service-bureau operations, enterprise platforms, and integrated technology solutions that keep organizations at the forefront.

timeline.title: Key Milestones
timeline.description: Major achievements that have shaped our journey and strengthened our position as a technology leader.

founding.title: Pioneers in Data Processing
founding.description: We begin operations in 1972 offering education and services in programming with languages such as RPG, positioning ourselves as industry pioneers.

serviceBureau.title: Service Bureau Transition
serviceBureau.description: In 1973 we became one of the first service bureaus in the country, processing critical business information for leading organizations.

maiDistribution.title: MAI Basic Four Partnership
maiDistribution.description: Late in the 1970s we joined Mai System Corp. as distributors of MAI Basic Four systems, expanding our enterprise reach.

businessServices.title: Enterprise Services Expansion
businessServices.description: Throughout the 1980s we deepened our business services portfolio, integrating technology and consulting capabilities.

networkServices.title: Networking & Infrastructure
networkServices.description: Since 1996 we have led transformations in networking, storage, and managed services to support modern organizations.

achievements.title: Certifications & Achievements
achievements.description: Our commitment to excellence is reflected in our industry certifications and recognition from leading technology partners.
